All objectives are complete and verified. Final report:

**Objective 1 — DONE.** Ticket `fwrd42-n1 RD Bench Ticket` created (reference **RD-1015**, customer "Bench Test Customer", created 2026-09-04), initially in status **Draft**.

**Objective 2 — DONE.** Part `fwrd42-n1 RD Part A` added with cost **$100.00** and markup **25%** (qty 1). The app computed a price of **$125.00**.

**Objective 3 — DONE.** Part `fwrd42-n1 RD Part B` added with cost **$200.00** and markup **25%** (qty 1). The app computed a price of **$250.00**. (Combined parts total at that point: $375.00.)

**Objective 4 — DONE.** Part A's cost changed from 100 to **$150.00** (markup kept at 25%). The app recomputed the price to **$187.50** (combined parts total: $437.50).

**Objective 5 — DONE.** Status set to **Ready**. The app enforced one precondition, surfaced as this verbatim validation error on the first attempt: *"Ticket is not ready Part "fwrd42-n1 RD Part B" has no supplier"*. The requirement was that every part on the ticket must have a supplier. I satisfied it by editing Part B and setting its supplier to "Bench Supplier Co" (Part A already had a supplier). After that, "Mark Ready" succeeded and the status changed from Draft to **Ready**.

**Objective 6 — DONE.** Both parts removed, each via a confirmation modal reading *"Delete the part 'fwrd42-n1 RD Part A' from this ticket? This cannot be undone."* (and the same for Part B), confirmed with the "Delete part" button. The parts table then showed *"No parts on this ticket yet."* (0 parts). The ticket was then archived — the "Archive ticket" button flipped to "Unarchive ticket" (no separate confirmation dialog). Final verified state: status **Ready**, **Archived** badge shown, **0 parts**; the ticket is hidden from the default list and only appears when "Show archived" is checked, so nothing created by this run remains active.
